cards.title: FTP
cards.description_short: File Transfer Protocol for remote file access
cards.description_long: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) allows users to upload and download files from a remote server. It is widely used but considered insecure if not protected because credentials are transmitted in plain text.

Upload a file to the server

cards.title: SSH
cards.description_long: SSH (Secure Shell) provides encrypted remote access to systems. It allows administrators to securely log in, execute commands, and manage servers over a network.

main_commands.explanation: Connect to a remote server via SSH
Connect using a custom SSH port

cards.title: Telnet
cards.description_long: Telnet is an older protocol used for remote command-line access. It transmits data in plain text and is mostly replaced by SSH due to security concerns.

main_commands.explanation: Connect to a remote Telnet server
Connect to Telnet service on port 23

Exit Telnet session

cards.title: RDP
cards.description_short: Remote Desktop Protocol for GUI access
cards.description_long: RDP allows users to remotely access the graphical interface of a Windows system. It is commonly used for remote administration of Windows servers and desktops.

main_commands.explanation: Connect to Windows machine using RDP
Login to RDP session with credentials
Start RDP session and enter credentials later
